title: calcitrapoides lusitanica
intro: Calcitrapoides lusitanica, commonly known as Rock Rose, is a plant species that belongs to the Cistaceae family. It has been traditionally used for its therapeutic properties, which include reducing anxiety and stress, promoting relaxation, and improving sleep quality. The bioactive constituents present in Rock Rose, such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, are believed to contribute to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and sedative effects. The health benefits of Rock Rose are thought to be related to its ability to regulate the nervous system and promote a sense of calmness, making it a popular ingredient in herbal remedies and aromatherapy products.
